date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the wedding timezone. Past dates are allowed.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

invitation.description: null until the invitation is created.

duplicateMobileGuests.description: Other active guests with the same normalized mobile. A warning only.

mobile.description: 7–15 digits, optional leading "+", spaces and hyphens allowed. Stored and returned with the separators removed.

guestEventId.description: The guest's own assignment, for the RSVP request.

rsvpStatus.description: A guest can never send PENDING (0017 #4).

attendeeCount.description: MAYBE: null; DECLINED: 0; ATTENDING: an integer ≥ 1, including the guest.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the wedding timezone; never a time. Past dates are allowed.

isOverdue.description: Due before today (wedding timezone) and not closed (0026 #8).

isDueToday.description: Due today and not closed: shown as "Due today".

notes.description: One editable field, separate from the description and the history.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the wedding timezone; never a time. Past dates are allowed.

notes.description: One editable field, separate from the description and the history.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the wedding timezone; never a time. Past dates are allowed.

eventId.description: An active event of the wedding; null for a whole-wedding task.

assigneeIds.description: The complete set of assignees: active members of the wedding (user IDs). Omit to leave assignees unchanged.

userId.description: An active member of the wedding (user ID).

subjectName.description: For ASSIGNEE_ADDED and ASSIGNEE_REMOVED: the person assigned or unassigned.

oldValue.description: Values before the change, by field; long texts are not copied.

newValue.description: Values after the change, by field. UPDATED lists edited long texts in `fields`.

totals.description: Over the whole filter, not one page.

paidMinor.description: The sum of the payments, in paise.

amountMinor.description: Integer paise (₹1,50,000 = 15000000). More than 0, at most ₹10 crore.

eventId.description: An active event of the wedding; null for a whole-wedding expense.

amountMinor.description: Integer paise (₹1,50,000 = 15000000). More than 0, at most ₹10 crore. Never below the paid total (AMOUNT_BELOW_PAID).

eventId.description: An active event of the wedding; null for a whole-wedding expense.

paidByName.description: The member's display name, or the typed name.

amountMinor.description: Integer paise (₹1,50,000 = 15000000). More than 0, at most ₹10 crore.

paymentDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD; today or earlier in the wedding timezone.

paidByUserId.description: For WEDDING_MEMBER: an active member of the wedding (user ID).

referenceNumber.description: For example a UPI or cheque number.

expectedAttendees.description: Sum of attendeeCount over counted ATTENDING assignments for this event. Only with INVITATIONS:VIEW.

guests.description: Including guests not assigned to any event.

overdue.description: Overlaps pending and blocked; CANCELLED is in no count.

byCategory.description: Categories with expenses, largest total first.

byEvent.description: Events with expenses and the whole wedding (eventId null), largest first.

upcomingEvents.description: At most five events dated today or later (wedding timezone), by date then start time, untimed first. A dashboard limit only. Only with EVENTS:VIEW.

rsvpBreakdown.description: Counted assignments per status across all counted events, past and future. Only with INVITATIONS:VIEW.

taskCounts.description: Over tasks that are not deleted (0026 #20). Only with TASKS:VIEW.

hasTasks.description: Whether the wedding has any task that is not deleted, Cancelled included, so a wedding whose tasks are all cancelled is told apart from one with none (0026 #20). Only with TASKS:VIEW.

upcomingTasks.description: Open tasks due up to seven days after today, every overdue task included; by due date (overdue first), then priority. At most five; never undated tasks. Only with TASKS:VIEW.

expenseSummary.description: Over expenses that are not deleted: Total, Paid, Pending; by category and by event, largest first (0028 #23). Only with EXPENSES:VIEW.

permissions.description: { [module]: action[] } — only modules that grant something.

emailSent.description: False when the email could not be sent; resend is available.

existingMembershipStatus.description: REVOKED when re-inviting a removed member (P10-3).

toMembershipId.description: An ACTIVE non-owner member of this wedding.

connectedAt.description: When the partner invitation was accepted; null for an owner by seat transfer.

emailSent.description: Whether the last email was sent.

resendsLeft.description: Resends left in the rolling 24 hours (at most 3).
